info.name: Workflow Builder API
info.description:
API documentation for the Workflow Builder service. This API allows you to manage workflows, nodes, edges, actions, and categories.

## Authentication
All endpoints require a valid Clerk JWT token in the Authorization header.

## Base URL
`http://localhost:3001`

request.description: Check if the Workflow Editor Service is running. This endpoint does NOT require authentication.
Get all workflows for the authenticated user. Returns a list of workflows with node and edge counts.
Create a new workflow for the authenticated user. The user is automatically synced to the local database from the JWT token.
Get a specific workflow by ID with all its nodes (including action details) and edges.

response.name: Success Response

request.description: Add a new node to an existing workflow. The node references an action and contains position and configuration data.
Add a new edge (connection) between two nodes in a workflow.

item.name: Actions

request.description: Get all available actions with their configuration schemas and UI schemas. Used by the frontend to know what forms to render for each action type.

response.name: Success Response
